node.statement: Let Pi_delta and (u_delta,h_delta) be the polar diffeomorphism and inverse from lem-stage1-smooth-polar-inverse. Since J lies in B_delta^{calH}(J) and Pi_delta(U,J)=U bold-dot J=U, both U and cU belong to S_delta. Hence A has image in the open set S_delta, u_delta composed with A is smooth into calU, and lem-stage1-polar-coherence-naturality gives u_delta(cU)=c*u_delta(U)=cU. Thus A itself is smooth as a calU-valued map.
